sections.heading: Ir a + infinitive: going to
sections.body: The easiest way to talk about the future is exactly like English "going to": conjugate *ir*, add *a*, then the infinitive.

head: ir
+ a + infinitive
rows: *voy a estudiar* — I'm going to study
*vas a comer* — you're going to eat
*va a llover* — it's going to rain
*vamos a viajar* — we're going to travel
*van a salir* — they're going to go out

sections.heading: Plans and intentions
sections.body:
Use it for plans and for things that are clearly about to happen: *Este fin de semana voy a visitar a mis abuelos. Mira, va a llover.* (Look, it's going to rain.) Ask about plans: *¿Qué vas a hacer mañana?* (What are you going to do tomorrow?)

*Vamos a* + infinitive also means "let's": *¡Vamos a comer!* (Let's eat!) With reflexive verbs, the pronoun can go before *ir* or on the end of the infinitive: *Me voy a levantar temprano* = *Voy a levantarme temprano*.

Other ways to talk about plans: *pensar* + infinitive (*Pienso estudiar medicina* — I'm planning to study medicine) and *querer* + infinitive.

sections.heading: Future time expressions
sections.body: *mañana* (tomorrow), *pasado mañana* (the day after tomorrow), *esta tarde* (this afternoon), *esta noche* (tonight), *este fin de semana* (this weekend), *la próxima semana / la semana que viene* (next week), *el próximo mes* (next month), *el año que viene* (next year), *pronto* (soon), *más tarde* (later).

examples: Voy a estudiar esta noche.
I'm going to study tonight.
¿Qué vas a hacer mañana?
What are you going to do tomorrow?
Este fin de semana voy a visitar a mis abuelos.
This weekend I'm going to visit my grandparents.
Mira, va a llover.
Look, it's going to rain.
Vamos a viajar a Perú el año que viene.
We're going to travel to Peru next year.
Ellos van a salir más tarde.
They're going to go out later.
¡Vamos a comer!
Let's eat!
Voy a levantarme temprano.
I'm going to get up early.
Me voy a levantar temprano.
I'm going to get up early.
No voy a trabajar pasado mañana.
I'm not going to work the day after tomorrow.
¿Vas a venir a la fiesta?
Are you going to come to the party?
La próxima semana vamos a limpiar la casa.
Next week we're going to clean the house.
Pienso estudiar medicina.
I'm planning to study medicine.
¿Cuáles son tus planes para las vacaciones?
What are your plans for vacation?
Voy a descansar.
I'm going to rest.
Mi hermana va a tener un bebé pronto.
My sister is going to have a baby soon.
Esta tarde voy a cocinar.
This afternoon I'm going to cook.
El próximo mes voy a comprar un carro.
Next month I'm going to buy a car.
Van a ver una película.
They're going to watch a movie.
Vamos a bailar.
Let's dance.
Vas a comer con nosotros.
You're going to eat with us.
Va a hacer calor.
It's going to be hot.
